Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 11
Performance Reviews
Performance is reviewed twice a year, in April and October.
Goals
At the start of each review period, you and your manager agree on 3 to 5 goals in the HR
portal.
Ratings
Each review gives a rating from 1 to 5, where 3 means the employee fully meets expectations.
The yearly salary increase is based on the April rating.
Improvement plans
An employee with a rating of 1 or 2 in two reviews in a row is given a performance
improvement plan of 60 days, with clear goals and weekly check-ins.
Promotions
Promotions are decided once a year in April. To be considered, you must have been in your
current role for at least 12 months.
